paper.title: Quiet-STaR: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Think Before Speaking

result.summary: 本文提出 Quiet-STaR，将 STaR 从问答数据集推广到任意文本，让语言模型在每个 token 处生成内部理由（thought）以帮助预测后续文本 [abstract][S1.p2]。方法包含并行理由生成、混合头（mixing head）以及基于 REINFORCE 的理由优化三个步骤 [S4.SS1.p1]。作者在 Mistral 7B 上使用 OpenWebMath 和 C4 进行继续预训练，发现零样本 GSM8K 从 5.9% 提升到 10.9%，CommonsenseQA 从 36.3% 提升到 47.2%，且无需在这些任务上微调 [abstract][S1.p3]。作者认为 Quiet-STaR 是迈向更通用、可扩展推理学习的一步 [abstract][S7.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：现有让语言模型从自身推理中学习的方法（如 STaR）依赖精心整理的问答数据集，限制了理由的规模和泛化性 [S1.p2]。作者提出，既然推理隐含在所有文本中，为什么不利用语言建模任务本身来教模型推理 [S1.p1]。因此，他们希望让语言模型从大规模互联网文本中学习生成有助于推断后续文本的理由，而不是只在特定任务上推理 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: We instead ask, if reasoning is implicit in all text, why shouldn’t we leverage the task of language modeling to teach reasoning?
Yet, training from curated QA datasets limits the scale and generalizability of the rationales.
instead of the LM learning to reason on particular tasks like mathematical QA, we train an LM to generate reasoning that helps it infer future text from a large internet text corpus.

method.text: Quiet-STaR 在每对相邻观测 token 之间引入辅助的“理由”变量，目标是让模型生成中间思考以更好地预测后续序列 [S3.p1]。算法分三步：在输入序列的 n 个 token 上并行生成 r 条长度为 t 的理由，并用可学习的 <|startofthought|> 和 <|endofthought|> token 标记起止 [S4.SS1.p1]；用混合头（浅层 MLP）输出权重，决定后理由预测 logits 与基础 LM logits 的混合程度 [S4.SS1.p1]；用 REINFORCE 根据理由对未来 token 预测的贡献优化理由生成参数 [S4.SS1.p1]。并行生成通过缓存前向传播并拼接对角注意力掩码实现，使每个生成 token 只关注生成它的 token 及自身 [S4.SS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: we introduce an auxiliary ‘rationale’ variable between each pair of observed tokens of the sequence.
In parallel across $n$ tokens $x_{i}$ in an input sequence $x_{0:n}$, we generate $r$ rationales of length $t$
We insert learned <| startofthought |> and <| endofthought |> tokens to mark each rationale’s start and end.
we train a ”mixing head” – a shallow MLP producing a weight determining how much the post-rationale next-token predicted logits should be incorporated
We use REINFORCE to provide a learning signal to rationales based on their impact on future-token prediction.
we cache each forward pass and concatenate a diagonal attention mask to the previous attention mask

experiments.text: 实验以 Mistral 7B 为基础模型 [S5.p1]。大部分实验在 OpenWebMath 上训练，作者预期该语料包含更高密度的需要推理的 token [S5.p2]；也在 C4 上评估，使用 16 个 thought token 和 4 个 true token ahead 的设置 [S5.SS1.p2]。评估指标包括 CommonsenseQA 和 GSM8K 的零样本直接回答能力，以及思考 token 对预测影响的分布 [S5.p1]。此外还进行了零样本 chain-of-thought 实验，在 128 个 GSM8K 测试样本上评估 cot-maj@8 [S5.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We conduct all of our experiments starting with the base version of Mistral 7B.
We perform most of our experiments by training on OpenWebMath, a crawl that emphasizes more technical webpages.
for our C4 evaluation, we train Mistral 7B with 16 thought tokens and 4 true tokens ahead and otherwise the same setup.

We evaluate 1) whether Quiet-STaR improves a language model’s ability to directly predict answers in datasets that require reasoning; and, 2) the distribution of impacts resulting from thinking tokens.
The majority vote accuracy over 8 samples (cot-maj@8) increases from 40.6% to 47.7% with Quiet-STaR, as evaluated on a sample of 128 GSM8K test items.

findings.text: 在 OpenWebMath 上训练后，Quiet-STaR 在 CommonsenseQA 上比基础模型提升 10.9%，在 GSM8K 上提升 5.0%，且提升随理由 token 数量增加而持续增大 [S5.SS1.p1]。在 C4 上训练也带来提升，但幅度较小：GSM8K 从 5.9% 到 8.1%，CommonsenseQA 从 36.3% 到 42.6% [S5.SS1.p2]。思考对困难 token 的帮助不成比例地更大，大多数 token 不受影响 [S5.SS2.p1][A7.F7]。在零样本 chain-of-thought 设置下，cot-maj@8 从 40.6% 提升到 47.7% [S5.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: On CommonsenseQA, we find that Quiet-STaR improves performance by 10.9% compared to the base language model.
on GSM8K, Quiet-STaR results in a 5.0% boost over the base model
this improvement consistently increases with the number of tokens used in the model’s rationales
training with Quiet-STaR on C4 also improves performance on GSM8K ( $5.9\%\rightarrow 8.1\%$) and CommonsenseQA ( $36.3\%\rightarrow 42.6\%$) but by a smaller margin.
there is a disproportionate improvement on more difficult tokens.
The distribution is skewed, with most tokens unaffected, while a small fraction of hard tokens see substantial improvements from the thoughts.
The majority vote accuracy over 8 samples (cot-maj@8) increases from 40.6% to 47.7% with Quiet-STaR

limitations.text: 作者承认，为解决问题所做的简化之一是尚未验证这些技术是否适用于从零开始训练的模型，且只将 Quiet-STaR 应用于 70 亿参数模型 [S6.p1]。Quiet-STaR 会带来显著开销，在生成每个额外 token 前要生成许多 token [S6.p2]。当前实现不支持动态预测何时生成或结束理由 [S6.p2]。此外，作者指出无法确知模型用语言表达的推理是否忠实反映其内部处理，且没有防止有害或有偏推理模式的保障 [Sx1.p1]。

evidence.quote: it would be valuable to understand whether these techniques work when a model is trained from scratch.
We have also only applied Quiet-STaR to a 7 billion parameter model, albeit a powerful one.
Quiet-STaR results in a substantial overhead, generating many tokens before generating every additional token.
In the current implementation we do not support dynamically predicting when to generate, or end, a rationale.
it is impossible to know that the reasoning expressed by the model in language accurately represents the internal processing of the model (i.e., faithfulness).
there are no safeguards against harmful or biased reasoning patterns if the model finds them useful.
